targets.requiredResult: Each governed archive mutation carries a caller-stable operation identifier that is independent of correlation, nonce and receipt identity.
The operation identifier is bound to a canonical SHA-256 fingerprint of the family, actor, mutation intent and semantic input; reuse with different input fails closed.
The operation identity, original receipt, canonical fingerprint and serialized successful result commit or roll back in the same SQLite transaction as the protected business mutation.
A retry with the same operation identifier and fingerprint but a new correlation, nonce and receipt returns the committed result without repeating business, audit, outbox or attachment mutations.
The sandboxed renderer-to-main archive mutation boundary supplies and reuses a stable operation identifier across retryable unknown outcomes.
Real SQLite tests cover commit, rollback, fingerprint conflict and a new-correlation retry after an injected unknown outcome with actual process exit codes.
